mechanism_failures: Independent verification changed dependency belief versions even though the dependency triples rendered into the extraction prompt were unchanged; this changed the extraction fingerprint and made the bounded direct-answer recovery unreachable.
The query compiler split a multi-token prepositional constraint such as Gulf of Mexico into Gulf and Mexico, allowing that fixed destination to be mistaken for the wh-output.
The direct projection instruction did not explicitly distinguish named fixed endpoints from temporal or locative wh-slots.

architectural_delta.semantic_fingerprint: When enabled, extraction state hashes the exact normalized dependency triples used by the prompt and ignores diffusion-only belief versions.
architectural_delta.constraint_entities: When enabled, the query compiler preserves capitalized entity names containing lowercase connectors as one anchor.
architectural_delta.direct_projection: The recovery prompt explicitly separates named fixed constraints from wh-output slots and projects explicit temporal modifiers.

execution_order: opened causal diagnostic if any query-frontier regression appears
paired control/HARA Shadow-C20 without between-arm inspection if Smoke-A passes
stop_condition: Continue generic no-training diagnosis and iteration after any development failure. Stop only on the full preregistered HARA gate plus committed safe-stop report, or before the next call would exceed the shared 2000-attempt/2000000-token hard cap.
